hangar.meta.v1.Condition.description: Condition is one observed aspect of an object's state, such as "Ready".

observedGeneration.description: The generation this condition was computed from.

reason.description: CamelCase machine-readable cause of the last transition.

status.description: ConditionStatus is the state of a condition.

hangar.meta.v1.ObjectMeta.description: ObjectMeta is the metadata every resource carries. Users set name, project, labels and annotations; everything else is owned by the system. See docs/decisions/apply-semantics.md.

annotations.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

deleteTime.description: Set when deletion was requested and finalizers are still pending.

generation.description: Incremented on every change to spec.

labels.description: Keys under a *.hangarlab.cloud/ prefix are reserved for the system.

name.description: DNS-1123 label, unique within the project (or the platform, for global kinds). An Invitation's is an email instead.

resourceVersion.description: Store revision of the last write to this object.

hangar.meta.v1.OwnerReference.description: OwnerReference points at the object that owns this one. An owner is in the same project, a global object, or, for a global object, one in the project the reference names; when it is deleted, its dependents are garbage collected.

controller.description: The owner is the controller responsible for this object.

project.description: The owner's project, when the owner is project-scoped and this object is global, as a RoleBinding owned by the ServiceToken it names. Empty otherwise.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.FileShareAddress.description: FileShareAddress is a share's server's address on one network.

network.description: Names a Network in the share's project.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.FileShareSpec.description: FileShareSpec is the desired state of a file share.

anonUid.description: The user and group squashed users become; unset is 65534 (nobody). Set only with squash ROOT or ALL.

networks.description: Names the Networks, in the share's project, the share is served on, at most 8, each once; empty is "default". A machine mounts the share from the first of its own networks the share is on. A network a declaring machine mounts from cannot be removed.

size.description: As a Disk's: a quantity in whole Gi, such as "20Gi", at least 1Gi; a size that is not whole Gi is rounded up. It can grow but never shrink.

squash.description:
Which users of a client the server maps to anon_uid and anon_gid; unset is NONE.

- FILE_SHARE_SQUASH_NONE: Every user keeps its uid and gids, root included.
- FILE_SHARE_SQUASH_ROOT: Root becomes the anonymous user; other users keep theirs.
- FILE_SHARE_SQUASH_ALL: Every user becomes the anonymous user.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.FileShareStatus.description: FileShareStatus is the observed state of a file share.

addresses.description: The server's address on each of the share's networks, which a client on that network mounts.

node.description: Names the Node the share and its server live on. Empty until its server is placed; once set it never changes.

phase.description:
FileSharePhase is where a file share is in its lifecycle.

- FILE_SHARE_PHASE_PENDING: Not yet served: its server is not placed, or not yet running.
- FILE_SHARE_PHASE_AVAILABLE: Served, and declared by no machine.
- FILE_SHARE_PHASE_IN_USE: Served, and declared by a machine.

size.description: The size the share has on its node, in whole Gi: spec.size once its node has room for it, and never less than before.

users.description: What mounts the share, one entry per declaring machine.

hangar.storage.v1alpha1.FileShareUser.description: FileShareUser is a machine that declares a share.

kind.description: The kind and name of what the machine was made from, in the share's project, such as Container "web".

network.description: Names the Network the machine mounts the share from.

path.description: Where a container mounts the share, as its spec has it; empty for a virtual machine, which mounts its shares itself.

description: FileShare is a filesystem in a project that many machines mount at once over NFS, from its networks. A server microVM of the platform's serves it from a volume of its own, on one node. A machine mounts only the shares it declares: a container as a volume, a virtual machine in spec.file_shares. See docs/decisions/file-shares.md.
title: FileShare
